'''Scarab mages''' are [[magic]] using worshippers of [[Scabaras]] encountered during the [[Contact!]] quest. Their magic attack looks like a swarm of beetles and are able to hit into the 700s, and very accurately. Scarab mages are able to extinguish a player's light source.

Scarab mages can be killed for the [[City Quest]] for "scarabs".
